# Version 4.150.1
> **GPU text and stencil fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 corrects native GPU text teardown and stencil-clear bounds handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Safer GPU text deserialization** — Fixes a native use-after-free and possible double-free when corrupt serialized GPU text causes early teardown. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
- **Clipped render-pass stencil checks** — Checks clipped render-pass bounds against the area whose stencil was cleared. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
